(1) THE 12:00Z 4h BAR CLOSED AT 2682.25 - 16.05 POINTS ABOVE THE 2666.20 THRESHOLD. At 23:00 it read C2660.68 FORMING and had moved 5.5 points FURTHER AWAY from the threshold than at 22:00; in the final 56 minutes ETH rallied 2659 -> 2682.25 and closed the bar through it. THIS IS THE STRONGEST VINDICATION OF L-006's FORMING-BAR RULE IN THE EXPERIMENT: reading that bar early, at either 22:00 or 23:00, would have given the OPPOSITE ANSWER to reading it closed. The 4h lower-low reading is materially weakened - 4h lows 2666.20 -> 2669.37 -> 2633.31 -> 2640.00 is a HIGHER LOW, and 4h closes 2684.16 -> 2675.48 -> 2692.23 -> 2647.90 -> 2682.25 have recovered. trend is NOT claimable short. (2) FUNDING SETTLED AND ETHUSDT UNCLAMPED FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THE EXPERIMENT: +0.009626% against the exactly +0.010000% it had printed at every prior check. That is a genuine data-quality milestone and it answers the 23:00 note's instruction (b). derivatives IS STILL NOT CLAIMED: 0.009626% is only 3.7% below the cap, ETH's OI is 11,882,798,837 against 11,880,750,615 = +0.017%, FLAT, and BTC's own rate COLLAPSED +0.002958% -> +0.000186%. An unclamped rate a hair off the cap with flat OI is not a positioning signal, and one unclamped reading proves nothing - exactly as one healthy book sample proves nothing. (3) BNBUSDT'S 4h ARTIFACT BAR DID NOT AGE OUT, AND ITS 4h FLAG VANISHED ANYWAY BY A FOURTH DISTINCT MECHANISM. The 23:00 note forecast the bar would age out at 09-25 00:00Z. A scan went clean because the MEDIAN OF THE WINDOW moved: not the market, not the print, not the calendar. That is the purest L-006 instance of the experiment and it is the FOURTH mechanism in four checks to move a BNB reading while 780.90 stands unrevised, after ageing out of the 1h window, being EXCEEDED by a genuine 783.34 print, and a 24h window roll. AND THE PRINT STILL FLAGS AT 1h: 09-24 02:00Z O766.84 H780.90 L764.10 C772.57 at rm 3.60. BNB IS NOT CLEAN AT EVERY RESOLUTION AND STAYS EXCLUDED. THE GATE, CATEGORY BY CATEGORY: trend NOT claimable either way (4h recovered through the threshold, but daily closes 2775.61 -> 2752.43 -> 2684.16 -> 2674.48 forming are still down and 4h highs are still capped under 2698.06). price_action REVERSED AND NOW OPPOSES THE SHORT: the 2660.00 floor that was 'overhead resistance' at 23:00 has been RECLAIMED, and the 1h 15:00Z bar CLOSED at 2682.25, ABOVE the 14:00Z close of 2659.74 - so the lower-close sequence the short rested on is itself broken ON A CLOSED BAR. FOURTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK at which a written forecast correctly told its successor which measurement to make first; SIXTH CONSECUTIVE WARNING of this shape. Stated, not scored; the clock is the review's call. BINDING N = 0.878% on the window containing the 14:25Z bar, required span 2.335%, UNCHANGED from 23:00. No lesson was loosened, reinterpreted, retired or overridden; no rule or risk limit was relaxed.
